description: A Jupyter Notebook file that defines a data-driven approach for generating SQL queries from natural language questions, executing them against a PostgreSQL database, and producing detailed textual answers based on retrieved data. The notebook includes code for importing libraries, setting environment variables, database connection, prompt generation for language models, executing and parsing responses, and constructing comprehensive answers.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining the user question with predefined instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message sequence to the OpenAI chat API to generate SQL queries or answers based on a prompt.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts a SQL query enclosed within ```sql blocks from the model's text output.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive prompt for an answer generator, including user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates token usage costs based on OpenAI API response tokens.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and retrieves the resulting data.
